# Suprabhat's Lab

> Free, open frontend tools and explainers at lab.suprabhat-dev.com. No sign-up, no paywall, no tracking. Built by Suprabhat Kumar (https://suprabhat-dev.com). Slogan: "Web for all, all for web."

Every tool pairs an interactive answer with a long-form explainer. Pages are static HTML and work without JavaScript as read-only examples.

## Tools

- [CSS Specificity Wars](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/): compare up to eight CSS selectors and see which wins and why. Shows (A, B, C) specificity, the deciding column in plain English, a part-by-part anatomy, a nesting expander that shows the `:is()` form, and a cascade resolver that walks all seven cascade steps (origin and importance, context, element-attached styles, layers, specificity, @scope proximity, order of appearance). Includes fix suggestions and shareable links.

- [Shadow DOM selectors](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/#shadow-dom)
- [How does nesting affect specificity?](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/#nesting)
- [The cascade order](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/#cascade-order)
- [Does @layer beat specificity?](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/#layers)
- [What is @scope proximity?](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/#scope)
- [Where do inline styles fit?](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/#inline)
- [Why is my CSS not applying?](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/#why-not-applying)
